structural_change: HCDMA-DBK 2026-10-17: new hard leaf. Measured hv15_dbk_cp gate (1f18141cb): the folded collar's 1,844 clk_cp sinks were smeared over the whole 645.8x360.7 cluster between the 8 banks (TT insertion 421.6 / spread 126.5), rst_n 793 loads unregistered, in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26]. Successor: the collar core + both 128x256 table SRAMs (abutted N-S stack, W band for the read/command registers, E band for the host-bus pin flops) as ONE compact 151.2x129.6 leaf with its own CTS root, rst_n -> one pin flop, every pin flop-first; it sits beside the controller in the hb_dbk cluster (W face -> controller E face, E face = F20 host bus).
